description: This file declares exported API functions for the Dslh RPC Extension Manager, including creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions. It is part of the DSL Home Model Implementation.

methods.name: DslhCreateRpcExtMgr
methods.description: Creates an RPC Extension Manager object with specified context handles.

methods.name: DslhRpcExtMgrCreate
methods.description: Creates the RPC Extension Manager instance with provided context handles.

methods.name: DslhRpcExtMgrRemove
methods.description: Removes the RPC Extension Manager object.

methods.name: DslhRpcExtMgrEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls the necessary objects into the RPC Extension Manager.

methods.name: DslhRpcExtMgrInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the RPC Extension Manager object.
